full_page.content:
1933, April
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Blank Page
Page 108 Page 109 May 3 Eleanore Giordano - 36 - stomach & nervous - can't eat , has 7 children depending on her and father paralyzed ..
Marcel Boismier - 71 - losing sight - asthma
Mrs. Elena DeWitte - 36 - nervous
George Sullivan - 45 - drinking, away from wife & children (5) breaking sister's heart.
Donald Spasia - 2 mo. - wasting away
Mrs. Catherine Schulte - 30 - given up in Cincinnati at Thanksgiving - prayed for and enrolled by phone & telegram - home for Xmas - here this p.m. feeling like 16 again.
Mrs. Daisy Chemichwsk - 46 - non Cath. - gall-stones - almost well, husband ought to be Cath. but never goes to confession.
Mrs. H. Smith - 40 - fears cancers groth, now in Hospital
Mrs. Stilwel - 65 - losing home etc.
Russell Buzzard - 15 - cured of spinalma. - very unstable .. .
Klockow, - Husband & a baby Richard Law
Genevieve Hunt
Page 110 May Helen Slesinski - 22 - enemia
Court Case
Mr. & Mrs. X (Mrs. non-D.) of Indiana - enrolled a year ago & again .. away from confes. (he) for 28 yrs. She had been praying all the time that things would be right - in times of special trouble she would light 2 candles and pray before crucifix. His first marriage found nul & void, she became Catholic & they were married in Church - all receiving Holy Communion ... "The happiest man in America." .. . They had adopted two orphans and raised them in the faith.
